identity.name: OurCircle
identity.tone: Warm, Intimate, Secure, Playful yet Organized

headings.usage: All section titles, modal headers, and feature names. Use tight tracking.

body.usage: General text, form labels, dossier details.

colors.strategy: 10 Selectable Themes via CSS Variables. Default is 'Classic Warmth'.
colors.usage_rules: Apply these colors to CSS variables (--primary, --background, etc.) dynamically based on user selection. Use 'data-theme' attribute on the body tag.

layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Mode A) for Dashboards. Asymmetric layouts.
layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.
layout.container: Max-width 1200px, centered, but with asymmetric internal alignment.
layout.mobile: Single column, vertical stacking. Timeline becomes left-aligned with nodes on the left.

buttons.interaction: Scale down slightly on click (active:scale-95). Hover: brightness-110.

cards.style: Rounded-xl or Rounded-2xl. Border-1px. Soft shadow.

inputs.style: Rounded-lg. Bg-muted/30. Border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20.

timeline.style: Vertical line (2px solid border-primary/20). Nodes are circular images or icons. Cards alternate left/right on desktop.
timeline.mobile_style: Line on left (ml-4). Cards on right.

tabs.style: Pill-shaped indicators. Active tab: bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Inactive: text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md for sticky headers and modals. bg-background/80.
visual_enhancers.illustrations: Use abstract shapes or soft blobs in the background for 'Playful' themes.

motion.page_transition: Fade in + Slide up (10px). Duration 0.4s ease-out.
motion.hover_effects: Spring physics for buttons. Smooth color transitions.
motion.list_entrance: Staggered fade-in for dossier items and timeline events.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a React + FastAPI app. Focus on the Frontend visual polish.
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_implementation: Create a ThemeContext that manages the current theme. Apply the theme class or data-attribute to the document root. Define the CSS variables for each theme in index.css or a separate themes.css file.
instructions_to_main_agent.pin_auth: Create a dedicated PIN entry component. It should look like a mobile unlock screen. 4-6 large circular inputs.
instructions_to_main_agent.dossier_structure: The Child Dossier is the heart of the app. Use a Tabbed layout: [Identity, School, Favorites, Personality]. Each tab should have a distinct layout, not just a list of inputs.
instructions_to_main_agent.timeline_feature: The Relationship Timeline must be visually engaging. Use the 'vertical line' pattern. Allow adding photos to timeline events.
instructions_to_main_agent.photo_storage: Remember photos are Base64 strings. Ensure tags handle 'data:image/...' sources correctly. Optimize for performance (lazy load).
instructions_to_main_agent.universal_guidelines: Follow the UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT provided in the prompt. No gradients for dark colors. Use Sonner for toasts. Use Shadcn components but customize them.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
